criteria.location_accuracy: Pass if start_ref, end_ref, and evidence references point to the intended discussion in the source transcript.
criteria.topic_relevance: Pass if the topic label accurately represents the main subject of the selected transcript segment.
criteria.boundary_quality: Pass if the topic starts and ends at reasonable discussion transitions without substantial unrelated material.
criteria.coverage: Pass if the selected span adequately covers the meaningful discussion represented by the topic.
criteria.redundancy: Pass if the topic is distinct and does not unnecessarily duplicate another reviewed topic.
